name: Chorus
author: Trance
description: Sixteen voices summed into one green trace across a phosphor screen, while hundreds of tiny hexagons swing up and down in time with the bass, leaving dotted arcs behind them.
init:
f0 = rand(1)
f1 = rand(2)
f2 = rand(3)
frame:
f0 = f0*0.9 + 0.1*sin(time*1 + 0)*bass_att
f1 = f1*0.9 + 0.1*sin(time*2 + 1)*bass_att
f2 = f2*0.9 + 0.1*sin(time*3 + 2)*bass_att
pixel: rot = 0.003*(sin(rad*1 + time*1.00 + 0) + sin(rad*2 + time*1.13 + 1) + sin(rad*3 + time*1.26 + 2) + sin(rad*4 + time*1.39 + 3) + sin(rad*5 + time*1.52 + 4) + sin(rad*6 + time*1.65 + 5) + sin(rad*7 + time*1.78 + 6) + sin(rad*8 + time*1.91 + 7))

layers.point:
q0 = sin(t*1*6.28 + time)*v
q1 = sin(t*2*6.28 + time)*v
q2 = sin(t*3*6.28 + time)*v
q3 = sin(t*4*6.28 + time)*v
q4 = sin(t*5*6.28 + time)*v
q5 = sin(t*6*6.28 + time)*v
q6 = sin(t*7*6.28 + time)*v
q7 = sin(t*8*6.28 + time)*v
q8 = sin(t*9*6.28 + time)*v
q9 = sin(t*10*6.28 + time)*v
q10 = sin(t*11*6.28 + time)*v
q11 = sin(t*12*6.28 + time)*v
q12 = sin(t*13*6.28 + time)*v
q13 = sin(t*14*6.28 + time)*v
q14 = sin(t*15*6.28 + time)*v
q15 = sin(t*16*6.28 + time)*v
x = (t*2 - 1)*aspect
y = (q0 + q1 + q2 + q3 + q4 + q5 + q6 + q7 + q8 + q9 + q10 + q11 + q12 + q13 + q14 + q15)/16*2

layers.code:
x = (fract(n*0.618 + f1*0.01)*2 - 1)*aspect
y = sin(n*0.1 + time + f2)*0.9
angle = n + time
